tagline: We ran our own rubric on ourselves at day zero. It's ugly. That's the point — watch this score climb in public.
summary: EchoRank is one day old, and AI engines have never heard of it: every money query in our own category returns Profound, Peec, Otterly or generic SEO advice, and our citation footprint is effectively zero — no Reddit history, no reviews, no third-party mentions. The one thing a day-old company controls is its own site, so that layer is done properly: 90/100 readiness, llms.txt, seven schema.org types, answer-first copy. By our own math that's still an F overall (23/100), because readiness is only 20% of visibility — the other 80% must be earned in public. We're publishing this baseline so every future re-audit is verifiable against it. If we can't move our own score, you shouldn't pay us to move yours.
